subject: Hosted API renewal & commit lifecycle — route throttles and burst bucket negotiation
messages:
From: Camille Chen <camille@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Morales <alex.morales@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API renewal + higher monthly commit — quick Q

Hi Marissa,

We're kicking off our renewal planning and want to lock in a higher committed throughput for Hosted API. Current commit is ~1M tokens/month; over the last six months we've trended ~2.2M and expect growth into peak season.

High-level ask: can Redwood support a 3M token/month committed plan for 24 months with a predictable per-route rate limit so our product team can plan peak-hour routing? Also curious about burst handling — will there be a separate burst bucket and how is it metered/charged?

Timing: legal wants an initial commercial term by EOD Friday so we can budget. I attached our usage snapshot for Aug-Sep.

Questions for the call:
- Proposed monthly commit and any step-up cadence
- Burst bucket sizing and overage rate
- Per-route vs account-wide rate caps (we run two heavy routes: /chat and /embed)
- Any discount for 24-month term vs 12-month

Thanks — happy to hop on 30m tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
Camille
VP Product, Acme Retail
[Attachment: acme_usage_aug-sep.xlsx]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Camille Chen <camille@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal + higher monthly commit — quick Q

Camille — thanks for the context and the usage snapshot. We can absolutely design a commit that covers your expected growth while keeping routing predictable. Proposal (high level):

1) Commit structure
- 3,000,000 tokens/month committed (billed monthly)
- 24-month term with an 18% volume discount vs list (vs 12-month at 12%)

2) Burst and overage
- Dedicated burst bucket: 500,000 tokens/month for spiky usage (administered at account level)
- Overage beyond commit+burst billed at $0.0045/token (tiered down with consumption)

3) Per-route QoS
- We can configure soft per-route caps and hard account-wide caps. Recommend: /chat route soft cap at 1200 reqs/min (latency-priority lane), /embed route soft cap at 600 reqs/min (throughput lane). If a route exceeds soft cap, requests are queued up to 2s before throttling; hard caps set to protect other routes.

4) SLA / latency
- 99.9% p99 token latency under commit utilization; for peak-hour hard guarantees we offer a dedicated burst lane pilot (additional fee) if you need strict per-hour throughput.

Next steps
- I can spin up a written amendment with the SLA table and pricing (attached) and route this to legal.
- Proposed call: Wed 10/15 10:00 PT to align product + legal.

I've looped in Karthik and Kimberly for commercial approval and margin checks.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RI_SLA_Table_v2.csv]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal + higher monthly commit — route throttles and burst bucket negotiation

Quick internal: 18% for 24 months is OK from a pricing deck perspective if we keep the burst bucket <= 600k and overage anchored at $0.0045 with a rebate trigger at >120% consumption for a sustained month. Kimberly — want ops to confirm we can enforce the per-route soft caps without manual intervention. If ops has concerns, call out the pilot for dedicated burst lanes and we can price separately.

Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Marissa / team — thanks, the proposal is close. A couple of legal/commercial redlines from our side:

1) Burst bucket: we'd like it set at 600k (not 500k).
2) Overage rate: we need $0.0038/token cap for sustained growth months (we can accept staged step-downs if consumption ramps).
3) SLA: we want a guaranteed peak-hour throughput clause for Black Friday week; the dedicated burst lane pilot sounds promising but legal wants contractual language (even if pilot-based) that protects us for 2026 holiday peak.

I've attached the legal redlines (PDF). If you can send an updated amendment and DocuSign link by EOD Monday, we'll aim to sign and start onboarding.

Alex and I are available for a short sync if you want to walk the redlines.

Best,
Camille
[Attachment: Acme_Legal_Redlines_20251016.pdf]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2025 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal + commit lifecycle — route throttles and burst bucket negotiation

Camille — appreciate the quick turnaround and the redlines. Summary of final counter and next steps: 

Agreed commercial terms (counter-offer):
- 24-month term, 3,000,000 tokens/month committed
- Burst bucket: 600,000 tokens/month (account-level)
- Overage: $0.0040/token with a volume rebate if monthly usage >3.6M (10% rebate on overage portion)
- Dedicated burst lane: we'll include contractual pilot language guaranteeing a prioritized burst lane for Black Friday week; ops will provision a reservation and we will commit to a runbook for failover.

Attachments included for signature: Redwood+Acme_Commit_Amendment_v3.pdf (pricing & SOW), RI_SLA_Table_v2.csv (latency / p99 targets), Acme_Legal_Redlines_20251016.pdf (redlines PDF).

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abcd-1234
Requested next steps:
1) Camille / Alex to confirm acceptance of the counter by replying to this thread (or sign the DocuSign).
2) Upon signature, Kimberly will kick off onboarding and allocate ops contacts for dedicated burst lane provisioning.
3) Karthik will finalize discount approvals and billing cadence.

Thanks — I’ll also have legal prepare a short amendment with the Black Friday pilot clause. Happy to jump on a 20m sync if helpful.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
